method: Deterministic bounded sensitivity of editorial scores; not empirical forecast or stakeholder elicitation.

definitions.utility: U_alpha = alpha*x + (1-alpha)*y; default alpha=0.5. Additive audit preference only, absent from production chart. Neither probability, expected risk reduction nor coalition value.
definitions.rank: Competition rank: 1 + count of strictly greater utility (tolerance 1e-10). Ties share rank; IDs do not break ties.
definitions.dominance: a dominates b iff a.x>=b.x and a.y>=b.y and at least one strictly greater, tolerance 1e-10; higher is preferred on both axes.
definitions.reversals: Strict pair order inversion only; resolving or creating ties is excluded.
definitions.box: Each assessed factor independently moves +/-0.15 and each null-imputed factor +/-0.30 around scenario prior; clip [0,1]. Exact monotone coordinate bounds, no distribution, no confidence or probability meaning. Simultaneous rank extremes need not occur together.
definitions.oat: One route/factor at a time moves by its signed sensitivity endpoint; all other inputs fixed. 384 probes per regime/prior. Report changed-route numbers and all strict crossings.
definitions.regimes: All axes normalised to 1. These are transparent analyst stress preferences, not elicited stakeholder weights. Proxy labels cannot add unmeasured frontier specificity, rights or international spillovers.
definitions.alpha_sweep: For every regime/prior also evaluate feasibility weights alpha=.25,.5,.75. Pareto set is independent of alpha.

limitations: Judgment scores on ordinal-like 0.05 grids are treated as cardinal by weighted sums; the arithmetic does not validate that assumption.
Readiness and remedy are distinct definitions with potentially shared evidence, not literal copies across all routes. Correlation is descriptive, not proof of causal double counting.
No international spillover, substitution, additionality, cost, rights-distribution or frontier-specific-effect factor exists; changing weights cannot recover one.
Programme scale, operational pilot scope and full-capacity aspiration are not a common denominator; near-term x can describe a drill while y describes later broad deployment.
Sample selection and route categories are not matched treatment/control groups. Group means do not estimate a causal coalition effect.
Missing not at random is plausible. Neutral prior .5 can reward unknown scope/remedy and penalise unobserved strength; varying one common prior is not a missingness model.
Boxes allow independent extremes and are deliberately adversarial, not likely joint states. OAT omits interaction; neither assigns likelihood to rankings.
No new country-level empirical claims are verified by this numerical audit; the saved evidence report is the substantive source audit.
